title: R2C activity
description: What the remote is doing: a tool call, a step, or reasoning. Display data for the caller. An unknown `type` is allowed and ignored by receivers, as are unknown fields.

id.description: Stable across updates of one activity (for a tool, its call id).

type.description: `tool`: one tool call. `step`: a phase of work that is not a single tool call. `reasoning`: the model's reasoning, only when the remote's owner allows it.

label.description: One line for the reader. Also the text fallback.

args.description: `tool`: only when the remote's owner exposes that tool's arguments.

detail.description: A short summary of the output or the failure, never the whole output.

parent_id.description: The `id` of the activity this one nests under.

delta.description: `reasoning` only: text appended to the activity with this `id`.
